notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
When Dominion Saboteur enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat.

uses.name: Dominion Saboteur
uses.cardState: as a copy of the creature with persist
